shortDescription: Creates, touches or removes files or directories

options.name: access_time
options.description: The desired access time for the file or directory. A DateTime string in the format specified by O(access_time_format). The timestamp is interpreted as local time on the target system. Timezone offsets are supported when included in the timestamp format. (for example, using C(z), C(zz) or C(zzz) format specifiers). When unset, the default is V(preserve) when O(state=[file, directory]) and V(now) when O(state=touch).

options.name: access_time_format
options.description: The format to use when parsing C(access_time). Defaults to C(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). See L(.NET DateTime format strings,https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/standard-date-and-time-format-strings).

options.name: modification_time
options.description: The desired modification time for the file or directory. A DateTime string in the format specified by O(modification_time_format). The timestamp is interpreted as local time on the target system. Timezone offsets are supported when included in the timestamp format. (for example, using C(z), C(zz) or C(zzz) format specifiers). When unset, the default is V(preserve) when O(state=[file, directory]) and V(now) when O(state=touch).

options.name: modification_time_format
options.description: The format to use when parsing C(modification_time). Defaults to C(yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss). See L(.NET DateTime format strings,https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/standard-date-and-time-format-strings).

options.name: path
options.description: Path to the file being managed.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(directory), all immediate subdirectories will be created if they do not exist. If C(file), the file will NOT be created if it does not exist, see the M(ansible.windows.win_copy) or M(ansible.windows.win_template) module if you want that behavior. If C(absent), directories will be recursively deleted, and files will be removed. If C(touch), an empty file will be created if the C(path) does not exist, while an existing file or directory will receive updated file access and modification times
